content:
hana: heads-up: onboarding Aurora LoRA merge (customer billing summaries). quick eval shows spacing inserted before percent signs in ~1.3% of cases after int4 fold+quant.

omar: example?

hana: expected: "Growth: 5%"  observed (int4 merged): "Growth: 5 %" (extra space breaks downstream parser)

lucy: hmm tokenizer stable? logits for `%` changed?

hana: token ids align with base, but argmax prefers a separate space token then `%` in int4 artifact. fp16 merged artifact is clean. baseline int4 without LoRA also clean -> points to fold+quant interaction.

quant-bot: qrun-id=qr-3712; quant-mode=int4-perchannel; batch=16; leakage_metric=0.011; token-drift=0.015

omar: can you repro minimal prompt with deterministic sampling?

hana: repro snippet:
```
prompt = "Quarterly update:
Growth: 5%
Note:"
for s in [10,11,12]:
  print(model_int4.sample(prompt, top_k=1, seed=s))
```
int4 merged returns "5 %" reproducibly; fp16 merged returns "5%"

lucy: suspects: rounding of per-channel scales on embedding or small bias introduced when folding LoRA into base in lower precision. Also check softmax temperature interactions with space token.

omar: try: 1) merge in fp32 then quantize; 2) runtime-apply LoRA (no fold); 3) bias-correction focused on `%` and adjacent space token.

hana: running all three now, will post numbers in ~20m.

(20m later)

hana: results:
- fp32-merge + naive quant -> spacing flips 0.9%
- runtime-apply-LoRA (fp16 adapter + int4 base) -> spacing flips 0.08%
- fp32-merge + per-channel symmetric quant + 256-sample bias-corr (targeting space and `%` tokens) -> 0.12%

lucy: ok shows merge ordering/precision matters. runtime-apply best but customer wants single artifact.

omar: for single-artifact path, looks like per-channel symmetric + targeted bias-corr gets us within acceptable range. Also consider small post-output sanitizer that collapses stray spaces before punctuation when confidence low.

hana: built a quick sanitizer (regex + token-confidence check) and reran -> effective error 0.03%. shipping artifact `aurora-int4-pct-safe` seems reasonable.

ops-bot: proposed artifact tag: aurora-int4-pct-safe-3712345678; recommended acceptance threshold `pct-spacing` <=0.1%

lucy: assemble quick-eval pack: 100 targeted percent-format prompts + 1k regression set, include merge script and quant flags, CSV diff, and sanitizer code. upload to S3 and attach runbook for SE.

hana: uploaded s3://redwood-evals/aurora/aurora-int4-pct-safe-3712345678.tgz; README includes seeds + exact quant steps + sanitizer snippet. opened ENG-ML ticket ENG-ML-6124 to track follow-up.

omar: nice triage. ping @lucy to review before we hand to SE. :thumbsup:

lucy: LGTM. create short note for console: `pct-spacing` regression alerts and link to artifact runbook.

hana: done — thanks team.

quant-bot: artifact metadata appended.
